data.name: Camping Resort Simulator
data.detailed_description:
You don't just build a campsite. You take a wild stretch of coast and turn it into a place people come back to.

Camping Resort Simulator is a cozy management sim about transforming a place. Begin with an empty shore and shape it, piece by piece, into a resort with a character all its own — lay out the paths, raise the bungalows, plant the landscape, and welcome guests who arrive hoping for a holiday they'll remember.

Shape a real place, not a grid
Every plot has its own quality and feel, so where you place something matters as much as what you build. A bungalow tucked into the right corner of the coast becomes somewhere special. The same bungalow dropped just anywhere is only a box.

Watch your guests live their holiday
Click any visitor and follow their day — where they wander, what they enjoy, what they were hoping to find. Your resort is never a spreadsheet. It's a place full of people living small stories.

Manage with your head and your heart
Keep an eye on the numbers, but the numbers follow the place: a resort that feels good is a resort that fills up. Read what your guests need, and let every decision open the next one worth making.

A place that earns its identity — slowly
Character can't be bought, only grown. As your corner of the coast matures, it stops being just a campsite and becomes your campsite — the one people picture when they think of the sea.

Made to be looked at
Settle in at the end of the day and watch the beach at sunset. Some of the best moments here are the ones where you're doing nothing at all.

data.supported_languages:
English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
